about:
# MovableObjectiveFrame

This is just a pretty early version for now, putting out a release for bug testing I guess.

This allows you to resize the Objective Tracker, make the height long or short, and move it around / lock it in place. **This is mainly a personal addon for myself** and some people wanted me to share it so I don't really plan to add any new features or anything. There's plenty of other bigger and more stylish quest tracker frame addons like [Kaliel's Tracker](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/kaliels-tracker) and [Hide Objective Tracker](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/hideobjectivetracker) and obviously my addon will be incompatible with these two (possibly more).

The quest counter is a separate addon called [Simple Quest Counter](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/simple-quest-counter).

A link to my discord for addon projects and other things can be found [here](https://discord.gg/tA4rrmjPp8).
